verdict.rationale: Trivy ships an official MCP server (trivy-mcp) explicitly advertising 'Natural Language Scanning: Ask questions about security issues in natural language,' integrating with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools. However this is a separate plugin, not the core CLI, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating the natural-language experience in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of natural-language query accuracy, broader IDE/agent coverage beyond VS Code, and first-party docs detailing supported query types.
